fields.description: Program Description This program is taught in School of Fashion & Art Design. About School of Fashion & Art Design Established in 1980\', the School of Fashion & Art Design of Donghua University is one of the best Fashion Design Schools in China. It contains every respect of the subjects and has the best equipment. Details>> An introduction to the design 2 Color picture (2) 2 Computer design software 2.5 Basic photography 2 Design sketch (1) 2 Basic modeling (1) 2 Three-dimensional composition 2.5 sculpture 2.5 Engineering and drafting 2 Computer design software application (1) 2 Initial environmental design 3 Building interior design (1) 2.5 Chinese and foreign history of architecture and interior design 2 Landscape design (1) 2 Display design Multimedia technology 2 Layout design 2 The traditional Chinese painting 2 Manual printing and dyeing 2.5 Craft art history in the west 2 Ring art computer animation research 2 Building interior design (3) 3 Landscape design (2) 3 Environmental facilities design 2 Building structures and equipment 2 Garden design 2.5 Urban planning and design 2 Lighting design Internship and Career Development Internship : the practical stages include drawing practice, professional investigation, design practice, graduation design, etc. Students are trained to analyze and solve problems so that they can keep up with the development of society and market. Career Development : Graduates mainly work with large design institutes, construction and decoration companies, property firm, art business and exhibition agency, engaged in designing, education, research and management. Some graduates choose to start their own business. Note: Students who have an insurance should deliver an attachment or a photocopy; students who don\'t have an insurance should buy one at school, the fee is 300 RMB/ smester.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of no criminal conviction Issued by the local public security authority or relevant government department in the applicant's location. The issue date should be on or after November 1, 2025. * 2. Statement of financial support To be filled out and signed by the applicant and the financial guarantor. The signing date should be on or after November 1, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Curriculum Vitae (1) Written in the teaching language of the applied DHU program. (2) Include basic personal information, self-assessment, hobbies and interests, skills and strengths, contact details, and educational background (with timelines precise to the month). (3) List participation in relevant activities or competitions, internships or practical experiences, honors or awards received, and certificates of competency, etc. Relevant certificates and supporting documents can be merged into one PDF file and uploaded under "Other Supplementary Documents" session. 4. Mandatory for application of art design related programs 1. Applicants for the Chinese-taught program majored in Fashion & Apparel Design, Product Design, Environmental Design, Visual Communication Design, Digital Media Art, or Art & Technology, you are required to submit the original latest art works: at least two hand-painted pencil sketch, two hand-painted color painting, and three design rendering relating to the applied program. 2. For applications to the two English-taught programs, a video-formatted personal art portfolio must be submitted. The video should feature explanations in English, covering the applicant's design concepts, demonstrating their understanding of professional knowledge, mastery of skills, and creativity, with a duration of approximately 3 minutes. 3. If notified by Donghua University via email to participate in an art examination or related interview (latest by June), applicants should respond and participate as scheduled. The results will serve as an important reference for the university's decision. * 5. Chinese Language Credential * 6. Passport (and visa) page A clear copy of your valid passport with your name, photo, date of birth, place of birth, date of issue and date of expiry. The passport should have at least 6-month validity. All visa pages are required if you have been to or if you are currently in China. * 7. ID photo Recent bareheaded (within six months), full-face, white-color background, two-inch certificate photo, instead of landscape photos or photos of daily life; in JPG format, less than 100K. * 8. Personal statement (1) Written in the teaching language of the applied DHU program, approximately 1000 words. (2) Describe family background and educational experience, reasons for choosing the major and motivation for application, significant experiences and gains related to the applied major, academic and career prospects and plans, etc., to showcase personal thoughts and characteristics, abilities, and strengths. (3) Must include the applicant's full name, the applied major, personal email address, and the date of writing at the end of the statement. * 9. High school academic transcripts Copies of the original certificate with the high school stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. Students who are currently in the final year can submit a pending certificate along with transcripts of all grades you completed. You are required to submit the official certificate and final transcripts once you receive them. * 10. High school graduation certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or Copies of the original certificate with the high school stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the original is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized. Students who are currently in the final year can submit a pending certificate along with transcripts of all grades you completed. You are required to submit the official certificate and final transcripts once you receive them. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. 2. Sufficient financial resources; no criminal record. 3. Applicants who meet the following conditions are eligible to apply as international students: (1) Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hongkong, Taiwan or Macao, and have obtained a foreign nationality. (2) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at the time of birth, and whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality (nationalities) and reside abroad. --- International applicants in the above situation must fulfill both two conditions following: ① Applicants must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), which means having acquired a foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. ② Applicants must have lived outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period from May 1, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (according to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year). 4. Age Requirements: Self-funded applicants: be at least 16 years old and under the age of 35. 5. Educational Background: have obtained a graduation certificate of higher secondary school, or its international equivalent, qualified for university entrance. 6. Language Proficiency: For Chinese-taught programs: a minimum HSK Level 4 Certificate (score ≥180) & provide HSKK score. Important Note: To enroll in an undergraduate program at Donghua University, applicants must possess genuine Chinese proficiency equivalent to HSK Level 5 (with a minimum score of 180) or higher. Higher scores are strongly preferred. An HSK Level 4 score (above 180) or an HSK Level 5 score (below 180) can only be used for application purposes and is only valid during the application stage. If a conditional offer is received, a newly obtained HSK Level 5 certificate (with a score above 180) must be submitted to the university before the enrollment & registration. Failure to do so will result in the inability to register and commence undergraduate studies. ① The test date on the certificate must be on or after September 1, 2024. ② Applicants whose higher secondary school curriculum and teaching-related activities were conducted entirely in Chinese may be exempted from submitting an HSK certificate. However, a certificate issued and officially stamped/signed by the school confirming that all courses and teaching activities were conducted entirely in Chinese must be provided. ③ Applicants who graduated from a full Chinese-medium high school program before September 1, 2024, must submit the required HSK certificate and HSKK score report as specified above. 7. CSCA Score Report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) For Chinese-taught Programs: Mandatory subjects are Professional Chinese (Humanities) or Professional Chinese (STEM), as well as Mathematics. Other required subjects should be checked here .
